unit: gzip bytes, KB = 1000 bytes. growth is the cumulative allowance over the 0.3.0 baseline after each 0.4.0 stage (null: no growth limit), the share of a stage is its growth minus the growth of the stage before and bounds the growth over the stage base, cap is a fixed limit in bytes (null: a growth-only row), and exact keeps a row byte-identical to the baseline while its growth is not null

frozen.why: Stages 1 and 4 add no code to the browser paths, stage 3 adds only its 0.01 KB share to the ISO BMFF parser and stage 6 adds code only to the rule entries. These stages keep every row that no group gates, and every gated row whose share in the stage is 0, byte-identical to the report they start from. Every row that holds the ISO BMFF parser is gated with the ISO BMFF share for each copy of the parser it holds, so the stage 3 parser change moves only gated rows, each within its share. The listed rows are the only other rows such a stage may move: the critical path, the entry chunk and the check chunk of the check and preset configurations in stage 6.

groups.name: first MP4 under the 25.00 KB promise
groups.why: The 0.4.0 parser additions may spend 0.39 KB, then 0.01 KB, then 0.05 KB on the first MP4 path, and the three configurations that inline the worker stay at or below 24.95 KB, inside the 25.00 KB promise.

groups.name: first MP4 of the default configuration
groups.why: The same shares, under the 24.00 KB promise of the default configuration.

groups.name: first MP4 of the custom worker configurations
groups.why: The same shares, under the 0.3.0 budgets of the custom configurations.

groups.name: standalone ISO BMFF worker file
groups.why: The prebuilt ISO BMFF worker carries the same parser code as the first MP4 path.

groups.name: Matroska path
groups.why: The 0.4.0 parser additions may spend 0.20 KB, then 0.05 KB on the first MKV path, under the 0.3.0 budgets of these rows.

groups.name: first MP4 of the other configurations
groups.why: The same shares as the first MP4 rows above. These rows have no budget in the size matrix, so only their growth is gated.

groups.name: first MP4 of the other configurations with a budget
groups.why: The same shares as the first MP4 rows above, under the 0.3.0 budgets of these rows.

groups.name: first MKV of the other configurations
groups.why: The same shares as the Matroska path. These rows have no budget in the size matrix, so only their growth is gated.

groups.name: both parsers in one file
groups.why: The single standalone worker holds both parsers, so it, and the first file of the configuration that loads it, may grow by the ISO BMFF and the Matroska shares together.

groups.name: ISO BMFF parser chunk
groups.why: The parser chunk carries most of the first MP4 growth and stays under 13.00 KB.

groups.name: ISO BMFF parser chunk of the other configurations
groups.why: These rows measure the same parser code as the parser chunk above, so they get the same shares under the same 13.00 KB cap.

groups.name: all own paths
groups.why: Every own path holds the ISO BMFF parser and the Matroska parser once, so it may grow by the ISO BMFF and the Matroska shares together, under the 0.3.0 budgets of these rows.

groups.name: all own paths of the other configurations
groups.why: The same shares as the all own paths above. These rows have no budget in the size matrix, so only their growth is gated.

groups.name: emitted lazy totals
groups.why: The emitted lazy total holds two copies of each parser, the one the worker loads and the main-thread copy, so it may grow by twice the ISO BMFF and the Matroska shares together, under the 0.3.0 budgets of these rows.

groups.name: emitted lazy totals with one engine worker
groups.why: The engine worker carries a third copy of each parser because it also serves own, so these rows may grow by three times the ISO BMFF and the Matroska shares together, under their 0.3.0 budgets.

groups.name: emitted lazy total with both engine workers
groups.why: Both engine workers carry a copy of each parser, so this row holds four copies and may grow by four times the ISO BMFF and the Matroska shares together, under its 0.3.0 budget.

groups.name: engine chunks
groups.why: The library engine chunks share the result helpers and may grow by 0.03 KB at most, under their 0.3.0 budgets.

groups.name: critical path
groups.why: The package code in the entry chunk stays byte-identical to 0.3.0 for the whole release.

groups.name: critical path of the rule entries
groups.why: Byte-identical to 0.3.0 until the last 0.4.0 step, which adds the check rules and re-sets the preset budget.

groups.name: check chunk of the rule entries
groups.why: The check rules stay byte-identical to 0.3.0 until the last 0.4.0 step, which adds the new rules, and then stay at or below 4.50 KB.

groups.name: preset data chunk
groups.why: No preset value changes in 0.4.0, so the preset data stays byte-identical to 0.3.0 for the whole release.
